overview: The revised plans distinguish townhouse, semi-detached and twin-villa configurations. Check the named layout, plot and specification together before comparing homes.
research.locationNote: Academic City, Dubai, as used by Danube’s project page. Marketing also says near Academic City; obtain the exact plot address and access plan. Future metro references are not operating services or guaranteed travel times.
research.priceNote: The live Danube hero displays AED 3.8m; its FAQ still quotes AED 3.7m, while Property Finder retains an AED 3.5m launch guide. These are different published references. The headline follows the live developer hero, not a confirmed available allocation or a price for every illustrated home.
research.paymentNote: Danube’s hero prints 30/60, totalling only 90%; no missing amount is inferred. Its FAQ instead describes 20% down, 1% monthly for 40 months and 40% on completion. The displayed 20/40/40 stages reflect that FAQ only. The brochure’s 1% headline and Property Finder’s separate 70/30 reference do not resolve a current unit-specific contract. Obtain the dated offer and fees.
research.handoverNote: Danube targets Q4 2029, with December 2029 in the brochure. This is an estimated completion, not a guaranteed key date or confirmation that every community facility will open simultaneously.

paymentStages.stage: FAQ reference · forty monthly payments of 1%

facts.label: Furniture and lift scope
facts.value: Italian Dolce Vita furniture is advertised; private elevators exclude three-bedroom homes. Confirm the selected specification.

facts.label: Dated developer construction report
facts.value: On 30 September 2026 Danube reported grading in progress and an infrastructure contractor appointed. No completion percentage is asserted.

facts.label: Planned home count
facts.value: Danube’s FAQ describes 768 townhouses and villas; this is not an available or delivered inventory count.

unresolved: The revised three-bedroom plan prints 2,400 ft², while the website FAQ says approximately 2,350. Plan areas are not plot sizes, net interiors or floor-by-floor figures.

The price and payment references conflict internally. Current availability, reservation terms, exact dated instalments, final furnishing inventory, parking, ownership conditions and approved service charges remain unverified. Images stay illustrative.
Shuttle, buggy, club, pool and wellness services are planned features. Operating dates, licences, access rights and charges need separate confirmation; no health or appreciation outcome is promised.
